items.title: OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure
items.summary: OpenAI says it stopped a coordinated campaign in which more than 15,000 accounts tried to copy the hidden reasoning of its models. The company ties part of the activity to people connected to Moonshot AI. But researchers found that the same attack kept working on Microsoft Azure for weeks, even against the new GPT-6 Astra. So far, OpenAI's protections don't seem to extend to the cloud platforms that also sell its models. The article OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，它阻止了一起有組織的行動，其中超過 15,000 個帳號試圖複製其模型的隱藏推理過程。該公司將部分活動歸咎於與 月之暗面 有關聯的人員。然而，研究人員發現，同樣的攻擊在 微軟 Azure 上持續奏效了好幾週，甚至對全新的 GPT-6 Astra 也是如此。到目前為止，OpenAI's 的保護措施似乎尚未延伸至同樣銷售其模型的雲端平臺。這篇題為 OpenAI 的文章指出，它阻止了一起竊取模型推理過程的行動，但該手法在 Azure 上仍然奏效，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.summary: 過去消費者要安排生活服務，往往需要在不同平臺間切換：訂餐廳要找訂位平臺，居家清潔要找服務業者，領藥則需要確認附近藥局與服務流程。隨著AI Agent發展，企業開始嘗試讓使用者不再逐一操作不同服務，而是直接提出需求，由AI協助完成後續流程。 統一資訊今天(10/1)發表OpenPoint上的生活服務平臺「i住家」，將AI Agent的代理人概念導入到生活服務平臺。使用者可以透過文字輸入或語音說出需求，背後的LumineOne AI會理解語意，將需求拆解成工作任務，再搜尋平臺上可提供的服務，找出符合需求的選項。

CEO Sam Altman walked onstage to cheers and announced Dots, a "real-deal AI" agent powered by GPT-6 Astra, "inspired by the cool agents that we […]

items_ai.title: Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call
items_ai.summary: Tavus has introduced Griffin, what the company calls the first "Human Interaction Model." The AI holds video calls in real time, processing facial expressions, tone of voice, and gestures. In a Tavus study, 48 percent of participants believed Griffin was a real person after a one-minute call. Previous systems maxed out at two percent.
